title: Photo Booth Hire West Sussex | Boothdrop Entertainment
metaDescription: Mobile photo booth hire across West Sussex, from Chichester and Worthing to Crawley and Horsham. Packages from £299 with attendant. Get a free quote today.
h1: Photo Booth Hire in West Sussex
intro: Boothdrop Entertainment brings mobile photo booth hire to weddings, parties and corporate events right across West Sussex, from the coast at Worthing and Bognor Regis up to the Gatwick hotels around Crawley. Every package includes a professional attendant, free delivery, setup and pack-down, unlimited sessions and props, with prices from £299.

sections.heading: Barns, beaches and hotel ballrooms: where we set up in West Sussex
paragraphs: West Sussex gives planners an unusually wide choice of venue styles, and the booth we recommend often follows the room. Along the South Downs, converted barns and country estates tend to have long, high-ceilinged spaces with exposed beams, which suit a full-length Magic Mirror or an open-air pod placed near the bar. On the coast, seafront hotels and beach-side function rooms around Worthing, Shoreham-by-Sea and Littlehampton are usually more compact, so a slim pod with a 1.5m by 2m footprint fits neatly without crowding the dance floor.

Around Crawley and the M23 corridor, the airport hotels and conference venues host a steady run of corporate dinners, awards nights and Christmas parties. These rooms are built for events, with lifts, loading bays and plenty of power, which makes setup straightforward. Further inland, village halls in the Horsham, Midhurst and Petworth districts remain a favourite for birthdays and anniversaries, and our smaller booths are chosen with those halls in mind.

sections.heading: Towns we cover and how we get there
paragraphs: Our team regularly works in Chichester, Crawley, Horsham, Worthing, Bognor Regis, Haywards Heath, Burgess Hill, East Grinstead, Littlehampton, Shoreham-by-Sea, Midhurst, Petworth and Arundel, plus the villages in between. Most routes into the county use the A23 and M23 from the north, with the A27 running along the coast between Chichester and Shoreham, and the A24 and A29 taking us down through the middle of the county toward Worthing and Bognor Regis.

Delivery, setup and pack-down are free on every booking, wherever the venue sits in West Sussex. We arrive roughly 45 to 60 minutes before the agreed hire window to build the booth, test the printer and lay out the props, and that preparation time is never deducted from the hours you have paid for.

sections.heading: The booths West Sussex clients book most
paragraphs: Weddings dominate the summer calendar here, and the Magic Mirror is the one most couples ask for by name. Its full-length screen, on-screen animations and a print for everyone in the shot work beautifully in a barn or a country house drawing room, and the guest book it comes with ends up as a keepsake. For tighter rooms, the LCD SlimPod is the affordable all-rounder: a touchscreen pod that needs just one socket, removes backgrounds without a green screen and still gives two prints per session.

The Retro Pod has become a strong choice for the county's vintage-leaning weddings and milestone birthdays, thanks to its classic photo-strip prints and an inbuilt printer that keeps cables tidy. For larger wedding receptions and corporate launches near Gatwick, the 360 Booth adds slow-motion video with music and instant sharing; we confirm its space and power requirements for your venue at quote stage.
list: Magic Mirror: full-length wedding favourite with guest book included
LCD SlimPod: slim footprint, one plug, packages from £299
Retro Pod: photo-strip prints with an inbuilt printer
360 Booth: slow-motion video for big receptions and launches

sections.heading: Weddings, corporate nights and parties across the county
paragraphs: For weddings, the booth is usually at its busiest between the meal and the first dance, so we advise planners to schedule the hire window to begin as the speeches end. In a barn, ask the venue where the nearest socket to the proposed spot is, as some older buildings have power only along one wall. A personalised print template with the couple's names and date is included, and we send artwork proofs before the day.

Corporate planners around Crawley, Horsham and Chichester tend to book for awards dinners, team days and festive parties. A branded overlay with the company logo, plus digital copies delivered by email, means the photos keep working on social channels long after the event. School proms are another regular fixture across the county from late June, and the props box is always restocked with prom-friendly items for those bookings.

Birthday parties in village halls and private gardens are where the enclosed Party Booth or the glowing Inflatable Booth earn their keep, provided the ceiling clearance and floor space are available. We will always check measurements with you before recommending a model.

sections.heading: Access, parking and setup notes for West Sussex venues
paragraphs: Many of the loveliest venues in the county sit at the end of single-track lanes with gravel drives and uneven barn floors. None of that is a problem, but it helps to know in advance: our attendant brings a trolley, a levelling base and a long extension lead, and will walk the route from the parking spot to the setup point on arrival. Upstairs function rooms in seafront hotels are fine as long as there is a lift or a wide staircase.

Marquee weddings on South Downs estates are popular in summer. For those we need a reliable 13A supply from a generator or the house, a firm level surface such as a floored section of the marquee, and cover from any rain. If a marquee is on your plan, let us know early and we will confirm the best booth for the conditions.

faqs.q: Where will your attendant park and unload at a West Sussex venue?
faqs.a: Our attendant will unload as close to the setup point as the venue allows, then move the vehicle to wherever the venue directs. For seafront hotels with limited parking, it helps to ask the venue for a loading bay or a short-stay space in advance. Please pass on any parking instructions when you confirm the booking.

faqs.q: Can you set up inside a marquee or a barn on the South Downs?
faqs.a: Yes. We regularly set up in marquees and converted barns across the county. For a marquee we need a firm, level surface and a reliable 13A power supply nearby. Barns with uneven flagstone floors are fine; we carry a levelling base so the booth sits straight and prints line up properly.

faqs.q: Is there a travel charge for venues near Chichester or Midhurst?
faqs.a: Delivery and setup are included in every West Sussex booking. If any travel contribution ever applies to a particularly far-flung venue, it is shown on the quote up front, so there are never surprise charges on the day and you can budget with confidence.

faqs.q: Do you cover the Gatwick hotels around Crawley for corporate events?
faqs.a: We do, and they are among the most common corporate venues we work in. Hotel conference suites typically have good loading access and plenty of sockets, which keeps setup quick. We can add your company logo to the print template and provide digital copies for your social media team.

faqs.q: Will the booth work in an upstairs function room with no lift?
faqs.a: Most of our booths can be carried up a staircase by the attendant, although the Inflatable Booth and the 360 Booth are better suited to ground-floor rooms. Tell us about the stairs when you book and we will suggest the right model for the space.
